preconditions.description: The number of BubbleCores N must be between 3 and 15,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= U < N and 0 <= V < N and U != V for U, V in connections)
preconditions.description: Each connection must connect two distinct BubbleCores within the valid range.
The number of connections must equal the number of BubbleCores.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum sum of all BubbleCores' potentials.
